subject: mathematics
concept: Introducing direct proportion and identifying proportional relationships
source_inspiration: adapted from Japan MEXT Courses of Study sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student scales a virtual recipe/mixture up and down and checks whether the ratio stays constant
exercise.pictorial: Student identifies which pictured tables/graphs represent a proportional relationship
exercise.abstract: Student determines whether a given table or equation represents direct proportion

misconception_flags: assumes any two related quantities are proportional even without a constant ratio

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
